name: geolint
description: Fast quality gates for production GeoJSON.

scripts.clean: node --input-type=module -e "import { rm } from 'node:fs/promises'; await rm('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.format: prettier --write src package.json tsconfig.json README.md docs/implementation-notes.md .prettierrc.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src package.json tsconfig.json README.md docs/implementation-notes.md .prettierrc.json
